searchText: 👋 Hello! hey! Ehlo! hello hi people who are already using Discord for some time, how often do you use voice channels? i've used it once we used to have our geth team standups two years ago, and it was horrendous lol yeah, discord is pretty bad 😦 I'm in it right now. before now, only tested it once we would not be able to hear one person or the other, so we switched to hangouts below 4 people it's ok, above it becomes unmanageable well, that was the case around 2 years ago interesting, so you are using discord as another chat app then? Someone was generous enough to "boost" this server, so better voice quality should be available. Haven't used it yet myself though oh, "boost" for money? is this how Discord makes money? I think the main benefit we'll get is using the thematic channels and it will be easier for everyone to pick up discussions as they are not interleaved. cosmetic changes + audio quality improve with money yes, that's how discord makes their money. And people like me with an animated avatar, lol so you had to pay for it? anyone can "boost" a channel. We didn't pay for it, but a contributor did I am keen to explore voice channels more for ad-hoc meetings interesting, maybe it does improve with the paid version, but overall so far my experience has been pretty subpar 😦 I have heard that games use Discord a lot it seems like a nice place to just drop in if the quality is okay With the voice channels it should also be possible to have some kind of a lobby where people just hang out and there's no voice unless others join. To have a sense of working in an office. That is what I wanted to try added another voice channel "witness". Feel free to experiment with them. Happy to add more if any desire because organising the meetings with so many people sometimes seems like such a chore, and then a bit of a disappointment 🙂 ha Ok, thank you, I saw the "witness" channel I will join in later, in 1 hour maybe Can we have an "nsa" (no strings attached) voice channel? 😄 to hang out anyone want to try? I cannot do sound right now, but can later I suggest we do collective reading of some ethresearch posts 🙂 so, I am doing an experimental hang out in the "witness" voice channel around 8:10pm GMT (which is in 45 mins), probably for about 30 mins everyone is invited I am in 2 of us, sound is good 3 sounds good going to run. audio sounds good with 6 of us! Discord voice calls have changed a lot since 2 years Now you can have priority speakers who make everyone else speaking quieter You can force push to talk on the chat room Also, check the voice channel settings and you can increase the bit rate You can stream a screen to everyone else But people have to manually join the stream <@118185622543269890> thanks, it was still on 64 kbs. Doubled it to 128 kbs I will stay for another 7 mins and then will go so far it was a good experience Hey everyone 🙂 i think this merging is a great step forward, much better than the telegram
